risks.title: Securities Class-Action Litigation
risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy faces significant securities class-action litigation which could adversely affect reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations, ability to access capital, liquidity or cash flows. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Securities class-action litigation could have a material adverse effect on reputation, business, financial condition, and access to capital.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy operates under federal and state regulations that are constantly evolving. Non-compliance risks exist, including those related to the DPA with the SEC and DOJ, which could impact financial results and operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Subject to evolving federal and state regulations; compliance with DPA and regulatory oversight creates ongoing risk exposure.

risks.title: Reputation and Brand Risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputation is critical to FirstEnergy's business operations and financial results. Damage from litigation, regulatory issues, or operational failures could have substantial negative consequences. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Reputation damage from litigation, regulatory enforcement, or operational failures could materially impact business performance and stakeholder confidence.

risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy must execute capital-intensive Energize365 transmission and distribution investment plan and rate filing strategy to support growth and system reliability. Failure to realize anticipated benefits could negatively impact financial performance. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Successful execution of transmission and distribution investment plan and rate recovery strategy is critical to achieving financial and operational targets.

risks.title: Weather and Natural Disasters
risks.score_rationale: Severe weather events and natural disasters, including those exacerbated by climate change, could result in increased restoration expenses, operational disruptions, and material liabilities. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Exposure to weather volatility and climate-related events that could increase costs and operational risk.

risks.title: Deferred Prosecution Agreement (DPA)
risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy is subject to a Deferred Prosecution Agreement with the SEC and DOJ. Non-compliance could result in prosecution, significant penalties, and operational restrictions. DPA terms extend through 2026. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: DPA compliance obligations create ongoing monitoring and potential liability exposure through 2026.

company_description: FirstEnergy Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, distribution, and transmission of electricity in the United States. It operates through Distribution, Integrated, and Stand-Alone Transmission segments. The company owns and operates coal-fired, nuclear, hydroelectric, wind, and solar power generating facilities. The company operates 252,959 distribution line miles and 24,157 transmission line miles, including overhead pole line and underground conduit carrying primary, secondary, and street lighting circuits. The company serves customers in Ohio, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, West Virginia, Maryland, and New York. FirstEnergy Corp. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Akron, Ohio.
